锣鼓: gongs and drums; Chinese percussion instruments
锣鼓点: Chinese percussion fixed pattern; percussion rhythm
饣: "to eat" or "food" radical in Chinese characters (Kangxi radical 184)
骣: (literary) to ride a horse without a saddle
鸣: to cry (of birds, animals and insects); to make a sound; to voice (one's gratitude, grievance etc)
鸣不平: to cry out against injustice; to protest unfairness
鸣叫: to emit a sound; (of birds, insects etc) to chirp, hoot etc; (of a siren, steam whistle etc) to sound
鸣哨: to blow a whistle; (fig.) (of a sporting event) to kick off; to get underway
鸣号: to sound the horn; to honk
鸣谢: to express gratitude (esp. in public); vote of thanks
鸣金: to beat a gong; to sound the retreat
鸣金收兵: to beat the gong to recall troops (idiom); to order a retreat
鸣金收军: see 鳴金收兵|鸣金收兵[ming2 jin1 shou1 bing1]
鸣锣开道: to beat the gong to clear the way; (fig.) to pave the way for sth
鹣: mythical bird with one eye and one wing; see also 鰈鶼|鲽鹣[die2 jian1]
鹣鹣: lit. a pair of mythical birds who depend on each other; fig. an inseparable couple
